parts.name: body
source_collision_objects: COL specified combined blocks and bottom runners

notes: Five pine deckboards, nine support blocks and three Y-grain bottom runners. Elongated wood grain, 3-percent board variation, worn edges, cavity dirt, thirty dark nail heads and an original fictional NOVA / HT / FICT-008 stamp. Nail heads stand 0.03 mm proud of the nominal 80 mm deck. The blue HDPE variant replaces the body mesh, not just the colour: seventy real rounded through-holes form five grid panels. Apply variants[].part_overrides by part name and then variants[].textures; the same common frame and six prescribed collision boxes are retained. SPEC EXCEPTION: the required single lower 300x400x68 proxy fills the fork openings, and the top proxies fill HDPE grid cells. These deliberately coarse, task-specific proxies override the general 1 mm concavity rule. This pallet may be fixed to the lift; it is not a fork-entry collision model. Metres, Z up, front -X, common bottom-centre prop frame, applied transforms. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree split smoothing and weighted normals; nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlases with 0.01 island margins. Each opaque rigid part has one RGB8 sRGB albedo, CPU Cycles 64 DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), excluding direct illumination and highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR and original artwork are packed in source.blend. 1024-square previews: CPU Cycles 64, neutral grey, three lights, front-left above. Instance colour variation may be multiplied by 0.97-1.03 in simulation.  Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
variant_contract: Merge part_overrides into the named base part; then merge textures. Unspecified fields inherit.
